name: auto-handover
description: When context usage reaches your threshold, writes a handover note over the cached conversation prefix, compacts automatically, and hands the note to the compacted conversation and to the next session in the same project

threshold.title: Trigger threshold (%)
threshold.description: Hand over and compact once context usage reaches this percentage. Clamped to 40..95.

handover_dir.title: Handover notes folder
handover_dir.description: Where notes are written: ~/… or an absolute path under your home directory; one subfolder per project.

cooldown_minutes.title: Cooldown (minutes)
cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum gap between two automatic handovers, so a still-high reading right after compaction does not trigger again.

resume_hours.title: Reuse a note for this long (hours)
resume_hours.description: A new session in the same project gets latest.md as opening context when it is younger than this. 0 disables it.

inject_after_compact.title: Append the note after compaction
inject_after_compact.description: After compaction, append the handover note to the conversation as a message the model reads and you do not see.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the UI and of the handover note: auto (from LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG), en, zh-TW or ja
